definition.def: A particular dimension of something is a particular aspect of it.
examples: There is a political dimension to the accusations.
This adds a new dimension to our work.

definition.def: If you talk about the dimensions of a situation or problem, you are talking about its extent and size.
examples: He considers the dimensions of the problem.
The dimensions of the market collapse were certainly not anticipated.

definition.def: A dimension is a measurement such as length, width, or height. If you talk about the dimensions of an object or place, you are referring to its size and proportions.
examples: Drilling will continue on the site to assess the dimensions of the new oilfield. [+ of]
I don't think it would spoil the dimensions of the room.

definition.def: In mathematics and science, dimension is used in describing spatial concepts such as points, lines, and solids.

examples.sentence: Rubin and colleagues did not assign greater weight to any one dimension in determining playfulness; however, other researchers have suggested that process orientation and a lack of obvious functional purpose may be the most important aspects of play (e.g. Pellegrini 2009).
"Good health is a major resource for social, economic and personal development and an important dimension of quality of life.
